import json
from dspy.adapters.types.tool import ToolCalls

# 1. Canonical form (dict with tool_calls) - preserved
c = {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}}, {'name': 'bar', 'args': {'y': 2}}]}
r = ToolCalls.validate_input(c)
print('1 canonical:', r)
assert r == c

# 2. Single object without tool_calls
s = {'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}}
r = ToolCalls.validate_input(s)
print('2 single:', r)
assert r == {'tool_calls': [s]}, r

# 3. Bare list
l = [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}}, {'name': 'bar', 'args': {'y': 2}}]
r = ToolCalls.validate_input(l)
print('3 list:', r)
assert r == {'tool_calls': l}, r

# 4. JSON strings of each
r = ToolCalls.validate_input(json.dumps(c))
print('4a json canonical:', r); assert r == c
r = ToolCalls.validate_input(json.dumps(s))
print('4b json single:', r); assert r == {'tool_calls': [s]}
r = ToolCalls.validate_input(json.dumps(l))
print('4c json list:', r); assert r == {'tool_calls': l}

# 5. Non-JSON string returned unchanged
r = ToolCalls.validate_input('hello world')
print('5 non-json:', repr(r)); assert r == 'hello world'
r = ToolCalls.validate_input('')
print('5b empty:', repr(r)); assert r == ''

# 6. JSON scalar string returned unchanged
r = ToolCalls.validate_input('123')
print('6 json scalar:', repr(r)); assert r == '123'

# 7. Empty list
r = ToolCalls.validate_input([])
print('7 empty list:', r); assert r == {'tool_calls': []}

print('ALL validate_input checks passed')
"

import json
from pydantic import TypeAdapter
from dspy.adapters.types.tool import ToolCalls

ta = TypeAdapter(ToolCalls)

# Construct via pydantic from each variant
for label, val in [
    ('canonical dict', {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}}]}),
    ('single dict', {'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}}),
    ('bare list', [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}}, {'name': 'bar', 'args': {'y': 2}}]),
    ('canonical str', json.dumps({'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}}]})),
    ('single str', json.dumps({'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}})),
    ('list str', json.dumps([{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}}])),
]:
    obj = ta.validate_python(val)
    assert isinstance(obj, ToolCalls), (label, type(obj))
    print(f'{label}: ->', [ (t.name, t.args) for t in obj.tool_calls ])

# Instance passthrough returns a dict (not an instance)
tc = ToolCalls.from_dict_list([{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}}])
r = ToolCalls.validate_input(tc)
print('instance ->', type(r).__name__, r)
assert not isinstance(r, ToolCalls)
assert r == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'x': 1}}]}
# and it still reconstructs
obj2 = ta.validate_python(r)
assert isinstance(obj2, ToolCalls)
print('instance reconstruct ok')

# from_dict_list still works
tc2 = ToolCalls.from_dict_list([{'name': 'a', 'args': {}}, {'name': 'b', 'args': {}}])
print('from_dict_list ->', len(tc2.tool_calls))

print('ALL construction checks passed')
"
